scope: Five real dev/preview HTTP servers; dependency scanning and speculative transforms are disabled only for this browserless startup test.

sourceObservations: createDepsOptimizer.close lines47289-47295 cancels discovery while awaiting scanProcessing; fast browserless checks may close with import scans still in flight.
scanImports lines14163-14215 cancels rebuild and disposes the esbuild context; concurrent startup tests do not need this discovery work.
isDepOptimizationDisabled lines14725-14726 disables optimizer when noDiscovery is true and include is empty.
React config adds include entries, so test-only post config hook clears them after React. Development environment asserts depsOptimizer is absent.
preTransformRequest lines37981-37984 performs unsolicited module warmup unless preTransformRequests is false.
diagnosis.fixScope: Only scripts/validate-startup.mjs and validation evidence. Product Vite config, source assets, canonical manifest, and other running servers are untouched.
diagnosis.failurePropagation: Assertions and close failures are collected and thrown as AggregateError after attempting every owned server cleanup. No process.exit or error suppression.
diagnosis.passOrdering: All five owned server close promises and stopped-listener assertions complete before writing the pass report and logging pass.
